75 Yards—Heat Winners: First Heat, G. Weston, 6yds., 7 4-5 sec.; Second Heat, J.
Team Result—1st, Belgrave "A," 11 pts; 3rd, Belgrave "B," 27 pts. George Weston, who has been amongst the prizewinners recently, won the 100 yards (over 40) from scratch.

George Weston will also, it is hoped, give us his assistance in this event. In the two jumps we shall feel the pinch most, although Tom Wiley should be good enough to gain us a few first places in the Long Jump.

He has been supported by George Weston, one of our veteran runners, on a number of occasions, and also Alan Bishop and Doug. Vine, both of whom are young and should develop into the 35-foot standard soon.

Cope a new member introduced by George Weston, showed his worth by winning the 880 yards in 2 mins. 1.6 secs. Our leading men in the 2 miles race were Archie Bedford, Frank Abberton and Tom Clinton, but W.
